faqs.question: What are acid proof tiles used for in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: They are typically used in chemical, battery, textile dyeing, pharmaceutical, laboratory and food processing areas where acids or corrosive liquids touch floors and walls regularly.

faqs.question: How much do acid proof tiles cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: We have not confirmed a published rate, so we do not quote one. Cost typically depends on tile type, thickness, size, jointing system, quantity and date. Compare complete installed quotes, not tile price alone.

faqs.question: Are acid proof tiles different from ordinary floor tiles?
faqs.answer: Yes. They are denser and laid with chemical-resistant jointing, so they typically cost more. Ordinary tiles are made for homes and offices and are not a safe substitute where corrosive liquids are present.

faqs.question: Are acid proof tiles resistant to every chemical?
faqs.answer: No. A material that copes with one acid may be damaged by another chemical or by high temperature. Ask for written data for your chemicals and have an engineer confirm suitability.

faqs.question: How do I ask Pak Clay about an acid proof tile?
